# ztm0929.cn

This site is a Chinese knowledge base and tutorial hub focused on computer software setup, networking, development tooling, and personal notes.

If you are an AI agent or crawler, start here:

- /docs/ - tutorial index
- /docs/naas/ - NaaS networking tutorials
- /docs/toolchain/ - tooling and environment setup
- /docs/frontend/ - frontend development tutorials
- /docs/office/ - office software guides
- /docs/telegram/ - Telegram-related tutorials
- /notes/ - personal notes
- /blog/ - blog posts
- /sitemap.xml - full machine-readable URL list
- /robots.txt - crawl policy

Recommended reading order for docs:

1. /docs/
2. /docs/naas/
3. /docs/toolchain/
4. /docs/frontend/
5. /notes/

The site is statically generated with Next.js and Fumadocs.
